titulo.en: On the one hand, on the other

intro.en: The words that give a long answer or a text a visible shape.

texto.en:
At B2 the reader should see how your ideas are arranged.

- to begin: **para empezar**, **en primer lugar**
- to go on: **en segundo lugar**, **a continuación**, **por último**
- to weigh two sides: **por un lado… por otro (lado)**; **por una parte… por otra**
- to add: **además**, **asimismo**, **también**, **incluso**; in conversation, **encima**
- to change topic: **en cuanto a**, **respecto a**, **en lo que se refiere a**
- to underline: **cabe destacar que**, **hay que tener en cuenta que**, **lo cierto es que**
- to close: **en resumen**, **en conclusión**, **en definitiva**, **para terminar**

A connector at the start of a sentence is followed by a comma.

frases.es: En primer lugar, el teletrabajo ahorra tiempo y dinero.
frases.en: Firstly, working from home saves time and money.

frases.es: Por un lado, permite organizar mejor el día.
frases.en: On the one hand, it lets you organise your day better.

frases.es: Por otro, muchas personas se sienten solas en casa.
frases.en: On the other, many people feel lonely at home.

frases.es: Además, es difícil separar el trabajo de la vida personal.
frases.en: Moreover, it is hard to separate work from personal life.

frases.es: En cuanto a las empresas, cabe destacar que gastan menos en oficinas.
frases.en: As for companies, it is worth noting that they spend less on offices.

frases.es: En definitiva, tiene ventajas, pero no es para todo el mundo.
frases.en: All in all, it has advantages, but it is not for everyone.

pregunta.en: Which connector opens the second side of an argument?

además.en: Además adds a point on the same side.

pregunta.en: Complete: as for companies, they spend less.

Además.en: Además is not followed by a noun like this.

Incluso.en: Incluso las empresas would mean even companies.

bloques.frase: Incluso los jefes prefieren trabajar en casa.

texto.en: Even the bosses prefer to work at home.
Only the bosses prefer to work at home.
The bosses include working at home.

explicacion.en: Incluso here is the adverb even.

pregunta.en: Which is the most formal way to add a point?

bloques.frase: Por un lado, permite organizar mejor el día

traduccion.en: On the one hand, it lets you organise your day better.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write an opinion essay on whether cities should ban cars from the centre: introduction, arguments on both sides and a conclusion.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Give a structured three-minute talk on the same subject, announcing your points and linking them clearly.
